question: Should `agent-transcript` automatically discover `~/.copilot/session-state/*/events.jsonl` by default, or should Copilot session discovery require explicit user opt-in?
rationale: This is a product and privacy-boundary choice about reading a new class of local session data, not a mechanical defect that review automation can safely resolve.

options.title: Approve default discovery
options.body: Accept Copilot as a peer local agent source because the implementation allowlists visible dialogue and applies fail-closed redaction before public rendering.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep the parser but require a Copilot-specific command option or configured root so users affirmatively select these local session files before discovery.

recommendation.title: Approve default discovery
recommendation.body: Accept Copilot as a peer local agent source because the implementation allowlists visible dialogue and applies fail-closed redaction before public rendering.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available default routing candidate for a repository-wide shared-skill privacy decision.
